name: 5.3 Normal Distribution (Lap Times) - Lab
_note: Built 2026-08-12. All ten authored fresh (lab kind): q21-empirical-vs-theoretical, q22-pilot-mean-sd, q23-pilot-median-quartiles, q24-pilot-percentiles, q25-pilot-iqr, q26-theoretical-median-quartiles, q27-theoretical-percentiles, q28-theoretical-iqr, q29-compare-empirical-theoretical, pre-frq-grade-a-normal-model-comparison. Points 10x10 = 100. BookSHelf 5.3 is a lab: stratify 36 lap times from the Appendix C dataset (Terri Vogel's 20-race logbook), then answer the same questions empirically (by counting) and theoretically (from a normal model) and compare. The MOM assignment checks the theoretical half (fixed) and gives the section's own Try It Now 5.4 pilot (12 values: 125.9..134.1) for the empirical half, so every answer is deterministic. The theoretical model is the pilot's own N(129.42, 2.52) per the lab's Analyze-the-Distribution step. Lab settings per reference/intro-stats-assessment-settings.md: 3 attempts x 20 versions, no penalty, no early-finish bonus, GROUP gradebook category, 2 late passes, no time limit. Pre-FRQ is authored-first (no lab FRQ to mirror): categories State the Empirical Value (3) / State the Theoretical Value (3) / Compare and Explain the Gap (4), dropped category STATE THE EMPIRICAL VALUE - deliberately DIFFERENT from the 4.4/4.6 lab pre-FRQs' dropped category (State the Theoretical Value), since a third repeat would teach the same lesson again.
